About NAPS

Building a Strong Foundation for Your Future

Naansana Parents Secondary School (NAPS) is committed to supporting learners through education, moral values and holistic development. Explore the school and contact the administration for confirmed official information.

🎓

Our Vision

To nurture learners who pursue knowledge, act with integrity and contribute positively to their communities.

📗

Our Mission

To support academic growth and personal development through purposeful learning and guidance.

✦

Our Core Values

Discipline · Integrity · Excellence · Service · Godliness

GET TO KNOW US

About Naansana Parents Secondary School

Our motto: Wisdom is Wealth. Learn about our educational approach, vision, mission and values.

Who We Are

NAPS is a secondary school community focused on education, discipline, personal growth and preparing learners for their future. This website is a school information and admissions enquiry portal.

Our Motto

Wisdom is Wealth.

Our Vision

To nurture learners who pursue knowledge, act with integrity and contribute positively to their communities.

Our Mission

To support academic growth and personal development through purposeful learning, guidance, discipline and a positive school community.

Please confirm the official wording of the mission and vision with school administration before using this text as an official statement.

Academic Excellence

Encouraging consistent learning, critical thinking and achievement.

Character & Discipline

Supporting responsibility, respect, integrity and positive choices.

Community Partnership

Helping parents and guardians connect with the school for guidance.

LEARNING AT NAPS

Academic Programmes

Explore secondary-level learning and contact the school to confirm current subjects, combinations and programme availability.

O-Level · S.1–S.4

Lower secondary education across academic and practical subject areas, with progression based on the current school curriculum.

A-Level · S.5–S.6

Advanced secondary education. Ask the school which subject combinations and admission requirements are currently available.

ICT & Practical Skills

Ask about current ICT learning, practical activities, academic support and available facilities.

Need subject or fees information?

Get confirmed details directly from the school team.

ADMISSIONS

Online Student Registration

Complete the student and parent/guardian information. Then send the prepared registration request through WhatsApp or email.

Before you apply

  • Enter the student's name and details carefully.
  • Provide a working parent/guardian contact number.
  • Confirm required documents and fees directly with the school.
  • Review the message in WhatsApp or email and press Send.

This form prepares a registration enquiry. It does not itself confirm admission or reserve a place.

Student application details

Your details are not uploaded to a website database by this offline page. Sending opens WhatsApp or your email app; review and press Send. Avoid adding sensitive financial information.

WE ARE READY TO HELP

Make an Inquiry

Ask about admissions, fees, programmes, school visits, term dates or another school matter.

What can we help you with?

  • Admissions and registration requirements
  • Fees structure and payment guidance
  • Academic programmes and subject options
  • School visits and term calendar
  • Student welfare and other questions

Inquiry details

Messages are prepared for you to send. No message is delivered until you confirm it in WhatsApp or email.
